new_options.fleet: boolean; applies only to logbook paths
new_options.onOpenLogReference: callback(reference UUID); only invoked while current mount/session/route/generation is active

checklist.record_phase: pre or post; required for evidence/guidance and their files
checklist.guidance_usages: files[].usages for distinct actual referenced steps; not inferred from orphan media
checklist.original: existing exact original UUID route/download; sources use kind=checklist, record id and real phase

logbook.original_workbook: not downloadable; metadata only; show extracted content via callback

guards: list generation before and after each asynchronous byte/hash stage
integrity: downloaded blob size and SHA256 must match current descriptor; SHA file IDs must also match descriptor SHA
presentation: h3 context, h4 family, h5 document; explicit text distinguishes evidence, guidance, original and extracted reference; no automatic images or external links
limits: DOM and controlled API fixtures only; no browser, layout measurement, production or server ACL evidence from these tests
